name: 2x2 matrix
oneLiner: a glass board stands up off a lit floor, the two axes draw with arrow tips and four quadrant panes settle with their names; 3 to 6 glyph chips fly in from their own side and land in their quadrant with a squash, the last one lights its whole quadrant in the accent
say: when the speaker sorts options by two things ('high impact, low effort: that's where agents sit'): cut in on the framework, each item lands as it is named, the hero lights its quadrant on the verdict
